## Objective

What capability, correctness issue, performance bottleneck, or infrastructure problem does this PR address?

## Approach

Summarize the technical approach and why it was chosen over obvious alternatives.

## Validation

- [ ] N64 ROM builds successfully in CI
- [ ] Build artifact and metrics were produced
- [ ] Relevant host-side/deterministic tests pass, if available
- [ ] No known fidelity regression was introduced
- [ ] Real N64 hardware validation is required for this PR

If hardware validation is required, describe the exact milestone test rather than requesting ad-hoc iteration.

## Performance / fidelity impact

Describe expected performance impact, timing changes, accuracy changes, or memory/code-size cost. Frame skipping, audio underclocking, or deliberate accuracy loss do not count as performance wins for the long-term project goal.

## Rollback

What is the clean fallback if this experiment does not work?
